Mumbai, the 3Ist August, 2023 


S.O. 3908(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (l) of Section 20A of the Railways Act, 
989 (24 of 989) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for the 
public purpose, the land, the brief description of which has been given in schedule annexed hereto, is required for 
purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of Special Railway Project, namely Daund — 
Manmad doubling projectin the District of Nashik in the State of Maharashtra, hereby declares its intention to 
acquire such land. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in daily newspapers namely “mharastra 
Times” Dated 25 June 2023 and “Deshdoot” Dated 24" June, 2023 under sub section (4) of section 20A of the 
said Act; 


And whereas, in 2 villages no objections were received and the same have been considered by the 
competent Authority accordingly orders have been passed; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section 20 E of the said Act, the competent authority has submitted its 
report to the Central Government; 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers conferred 
by sub-section () of section 20 E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands specified in 
the schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further , in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20 E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed 
hereto shall vest absolutely in the Central government free from all encumbrances.

या एग्रीगेटर/फैसिलिटेटर के घटक सहायक जनरल लेज़र (सीएसजीएल) खाते या Reet डायरेक्ट' के तहत ‘Rice खाता' 
(आरडीजी खाता) आरबीआई के साथ एक Aree खाता रखना होगा। 


ख. योजना के तहत, एक निवेशक नीलामी में केवल एक ही बोली लगा सकता है। इस आशय का एक वचनपत्र कि निवेशक 
केवल एक ही बोली लगा रहा है, उसे एग्रीगेटर/फैसिलिटेटर द्वारा प्राप्त करना होगा और रिकॉर्ड में रखना होगा। 


बोलियां लगाना: 

ग. प्रत्येक एग्रीगेटर/फैसिलिटेटर अपने घटकों से प्राप्त दृढ़ आदेशों के आधार पर अपने सभी घटकों की ओर से भारतीय रिजर्व 
बैंक कोर बैंकिंग सॉल्यूशन (ई-कुबेर) प्रणाली पर इलेक्ट्रॉनिक प्रारूप में एकल समेकित गैर-प्रतिस्पर्थी बोली प्रस्तुत करेगा। 
भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक कोर बैंकिंग सॉल्यूशन (ई-कुबेर) प्रणाली की सामान्य विफलता जैसी असाधारण परिस्थितियों को 
छोड़कर, भौतिक रूप में गैर-प्रतिस्पर्धी बोली स्वीकार नहीं की जाएगी। 
बोलियों का आवंटन: 

घ. एग्रीगेटर/फैसिलिटेटर को गैर-प्रतिस्पर्धी खंड के तहत आवंटन प्रतिफल/मूल्य की भारित औसत दर पर होगा जो प्रतिस्पर्धी 


बोली के आधार पर नीलामी में सामने आएगा प्रतिभूतियां एग्रीगेटर/फैसिलिटेटर को जारी करने की तारीख को भुगतान 
के बदले जारी की जाएंगी, भले ही उन्होंने अपने ग्राहकों से भुगतान प्राप्त किया हो।

VII. 


यदि बोली की कुल राशि आरक्षित राशि (अधिसूचित राशि का 5%) से अधिक है, तो आनुपातिक आवंटन किया जाएगा। 
आंशिक आवंटन के मामले में, यह एग्रीगेटर/फैसिलिटेटर की जिम्मेदारी होगी कि वे अपने ग्राहकों को पारदर्शी तरीके से 
प्रतिभूतियों का उचित आवंटन करें। 

यदि बोली की कुल राशि आरक्षित राशि से कम है, तो कमी को प्रतिस्पर्धी हिस्से में ले जाया जाएगा। 

सुरक्षा का मुद्दा: 

भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक द्वारा प्रतिभूति केवल एसजीएल रूप में जारी की जाएगी। एग्रीगेटर/फैसिलिटेटर को गैर-प्रतिस्पर्धी 
बोलियों की निविदा के समय उनके मुख्य एसजीएल या सीएसजीएल खाते में जमा की जाने वाली राशि (अंकित मूल्य) को 
स्पष्ट रूप से इंगित करना होगा। 

बाद में निवेशक के कहने पर मुख्य एसजीएल खाते से भौतिक रूप में डिलीवरी की अनुमति है। 

यह एग्रीगेटर/फैसिलिटेटर की जिम्मेदारी होगी कि वे अपने ग्राहकों को प्रतिभूतियां दें। असाधारण परिस्थितियों को 
छोड़कर, ग्राहकों को प्रतिभूतियों का हस्तांतरण जारी होने की तारीख से पांच कार्य दिवसों के भीतर पूरा किया जाना 
चाहिए। 

ग्राहकों से लिया जाने वाला कमीशन/ब्रोकरेज 


एग्रीगेटर/सुविधाकर्ता अपने ग्राहकों को यह सेवा प्रदान करने के लिए ब्रोकरेज/कमीशन/सेवा शुल्क के रूप में प्रति ₹ 400 
पर छह पैसे तक की वसूली कर सकते हैं। ऐसी लागतों को बिक्री मूल्य में शामिल किया जा सकता है या ग्राहकों से अलग 
से वसूल किया जा सकता है। 

यदि प्रतिभूतियां जारी होने की तिथि के बाद प्रतिभूतियों को स्थानांतरित किया जाता है, तो ग्राहक द्वारा 
एग्रीगेटर/फैसिलिटेटर को देय प्रतिफल राशि में जारी होने की तारीख से अर्जित ब्याज शामिल होगा। 

ग्राहकों से प्रतिभूतियों की लागत, उपार्जित ब्याज, जहां कहीं लागू हो, और दलाली/कमीशन/सेवा प्रभारों के लिए ग्राहक से 
अनुबंध के अनुसार एग्रीगेटर/सुविधाकर्ता द्वारा भुगतान प्राप्त करने के तौर-तरीके तय किए जा सकते हैं। 

यह ध्यान दिया जा सकता है कि कोई अन्य लागत, जैसे कि फंडिंग लागत, को मूल्य में नहीं बनाया जाना चाहिए या 
ग्राहक से वसूल नहीं किया जाना चाहिए। 


रिपोर्टिंग आवश्यकताएं: 


एग्रीगेटर्स/फैसिलिटेटरों को योजना के तहत संचालन से संबंधित जानकारी भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक (बैंक) को प्रस्तुत करनी होगी, 
जैसा कि समय-समय पर बैंक द्वारा निर्धारित समय सीमा के भीतर कहा जा सकता है। 


VII. उपरोक्त दिशानिर्देश बैंक द्वारा समीक्षा के अधीन हैं और तदनुसार, यदि और जब आवश्यक समझा जाता है, तो योजना में 
संशोधन किया जाएगा।

Annex 
Scheme for Non-competitive Bidding Facility in the Auction of 
Government of India Dated Securities and Treasury Bills 
I. Scope: With a view to encouraging wider participation and retail holding of Government securities, retail 


investors are allowed participation on “non-competitive” basis in select auctions of dated Government of India 
(Gol) securities and Treasury Bills. 


Il. Definitions: For the purpose of this scheme, the terms shall bear the meaning assigned to them as under: 


a. Retail investor is any person, including individuals, firms, companies, corporate bodies, institutions, 
provident funds, trusts, and any other entity as may be prescribed by RBI. 


b. ‘Aggregator/Facilitator’ means a Scheduled Bank or Primary Dealer or Specified Stock Exchange or any 
other entity approved by RBI, permitted to aggregate the bids received from the investors and submit a 
single bid in the non-competitive segment of the primary auction. 


c. ‘Specified stock exchange’ means SEBI recognized Stock Exchange, which have received No Objection 
Certificate (NOC) from SEBI to act as aggregator/facilitator in the primary auction segment. 


d. ‘Eligible Provident Funds’ are those non-government provident funds governed by the Provident Funds 
Act, 925 whose investment pattern is decided by the Government of India.

IV. 


Eligibility: 
a. Participation on a non-competitive basis in the auctions will be open to a retail investor who: 


i. Does not maintain current account (CA) or subsidiary General Ledger (SGL) account with the 
Reserve Bank of India; and 


ii. Submits the bid indirectly through an Aggregator/Facilitator permitted under the scheme; or 
iii. Maintains the ‘Retail Direct Gilt Account’ (RDG Account) with RBI 


Exceptions: 
a. Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) and Cooperative Banks: 


i. Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) and Cooperative Banks shall be covered under this Scheme only in 
the auctions of dated securities in view of their statutory obligations. 


ii. Since these banks maintain SGL account and current account with the Reserve Bank of India, they 
shall be eligible to submit their non-competitive bids directly. 


b. State Governments, eligible provident funds and Others: 


i. State Governments, eligible provident funds in India, the Nepal Rashtra Bank, Royal Monetary 
Authority of Bhutan and any Person or Institution, specified by the Bank, with the approval of 
Government, shall be covered under this scheme only in the auctions of Treasury Bills. 


ii. These bids will be outside the notified amount. 
iii. There will not be any restriction on the maximum amount of bid for these entities. 


Quantum: Allocation of non-competitive bids from retail investors will be restricted to a maximum of five 
percent of the aggregate nominal amount of the issue within the notified amount as specified by the 
Government of India, or any other percentage determined by Reserve Bank of India. 


Amount of Bid: 


a. The minimum amount for bidding will be =l0,000 (face value) and therefore in multiples in रे 0,000 as 
hitherto. 


b. In the auctions of Gol dated securities, the retail investors can make a single bid for an amount not more 
than Rupees Two crore (face value) per security per auction. 


VI. Other Operational Guidelines: 


a. The retail investor desirous of participating in the auction under the Scheme would be required to 
maintain a depository account with any of the depositories or a gilt accounS under the constituent 
subsidiary general ledger (CSGL) account of Aggregator/Facilitator or ‘Retail Direct Gilt Account’ 
(RDG Account) with RBI. 


b. Under the Scheme, an investor can make only a single bid in an auction. An undertaking to the effect that 
the investor is making only a single bid will have to obtained and kept on record by the 
Aggregator/Facilitator. 


Submission of Bids: 


c. Each Aggregator/Facilitator on the basis of firm orders received from their constituents with submit a 
single consolidated non-competitive bid on behalf of all its constituents in electronic format on the 
Reserve Bank of India Core Banking Solution (E-Kuber) system. Except in extraordinary circumstances 
such as general failure of the Reserve Bank of India Core Banking Solution (E-Kuber) system, non- 
competitive bid in physical form will not be accepted. 


Allotment of Bids: 


d. Allotment under the non-competitive segment to the Aggregator/Facilitator will be at the weighted 
average rate of yield/price that will emerge in the auction on the basis of the competitive bidding. The 
securities will be issued to the Aggregator/Facilitator against payment on the date of issue irrespective of 
whether they have received payment from their clients. 


e. Incase the aggregate amount of bid is more than the reserved amount (5% of notified amount), pro rata 
allotment would be made. In case of partial allotments, it will be the responsibility of the 
Aggregator/Facilitator to appropriately allocate securities to their clients in a transparent manner.

stretch of land from K.M. -2.948 to K.M. 4.860 in the District of Palwal in the state of Haryana hereby declares its 
intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition & use of such land for the aforesaid purpose 
under sub-section (l) of section 20D of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely the Sub Divisional Officer -Cum- 
Competent Authority (LA), Palwal in writing & shall set-out the grounds thereof & the Competent Authority shall 
give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all 
such objections & after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, 
either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 20D of the said Act shall be 
final. The land plans & other details of the land covered under this notification are available & can be inspected by the 
interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 4th September, 2023 


S.O. 3902(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 20A of the Railways 
(Amendment) Act, 2008 ([] of 2008) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being 
satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is been given in the Schedule below, is 
required for the purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of the Special Railway Project, 
namely, “Haryana Orbital Rail Corridor Project from Palwal to Sonipat via Sohna, Manesar and Kharkhoda” New 
Broad Gauge Double Rail Line on the stretch of land from K.M. 37.000 to K.M. 50.350 in the District of Gurugram in 
the state of Haryana, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose 
under sub-section (l) of section 20D of the said Act;. 


Every such objection shall be made to the competent authority, namely, Sub-Divisional Officer (Civil), 
Gurugram (Land Acquisition Section) in his office at Gurgaon in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof, and the 
competent authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner, and 
may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the competent authority thinks 
necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the competent authority under sub-section (2) of section 20D of the said Act shall be final 
The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected by the 
interested person at the aforesaid office of the competent authority.

NOTIFICATION 

Mumbai, the 3Ist August, 2023 


S.O. 390(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (l) of Section 20A of the Railways Act, 
989 (24 of 989) and Railway (Amendment) Act, 2008 (! of 2008) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the 
Central Government, after being satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which has been 
given in schedule annexed hereto, is required for purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of 
Special Railway Project, namely Itarsi - Nagpur Balance 37१ line under which Godhani - Bharatwada Rail Over 
Rail in the district of Nagpur in the State of Maharashtra, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 

Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose 
under sub-section (l) of section 20D of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority namely, Sub-Divisional Officer and Land 
Acquisition Officer, Nagpur(Rural), Nagpur, Maharashtra in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof, and the 
Competent Authority shall give the objector the opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner 
and may, after hearing such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority 
thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections.

MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS 
[Northern Railway (Construction Organization)] 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 4th September, 2023 


S.O. 3904(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by the sub-section () of section 20A of the Railways 
(Amendment) Act, 2008 (/l of 2008) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being 
satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is been given in the Schedule below, is 
required for the purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of the Special Railway Project, 
namely, “Haryana Orbital Rail Corridor Project from Palwal to Sonipat via Sohna, Manesar and Kharkhoda” New 
Broad Gauge Double Rail Line on the stretch of land from K.M. !2.900 to K.M. 37.000 in the District of Nuh in the 
state of Haryana, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose 
under sub-section (l) of section 20D of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the competent authority, namely, District Revenue Officer (Civil), Nuh 
(Land Acquisition Section) in his office at Nuh in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof, and the competent 
authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner, and may, after 
hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the competent authority thinks necessary, 
by order, either allow or disallow the objections.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 4th September, 2023 


5.0. 3900(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 20A of the Railways 
(Amendment) Act, 2008 (11 of 2008) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being 
satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is been given in the Schedule below, is 
required for the purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of the Special Railway Project, 
namely, “Haryana Orbital Rail Corridor Project from Palwal to Sonipat via Sohna, Manesar and Kharkhoda” New 
Broad Gauge Double Rail Line on the stretch of land from K.M. 4.860 to K.M. 12.900 in the District of Gurugram in 
the state of Haryana, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land; 


Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose 
under sub-section (1) of section 20D of the said Act; 


Every such objection shall be made to the competent authority, namely, Sub-Divisional Officer (Civil), 
Sohna (Land Acquisition Section) in his office at Gurgaon in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof, and the 
competent authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner, and 
may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the competent authority thinks 
necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections; 


Any order made by the competent authority under sub-section (2) of section 20D of the said Act shall be 
final; The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected by 
the interested person at the aforesaid office of the competent authority.

New Delhi, the Ist September, 2023 


G.S.R. 650(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution, the 
President hereby makes the following rules regulating the method of recruitment to the post of Additional Registrar, 
Joint Registrar, Deputy Registrar, Assistant Registrar, Senior Cooperative Officer and Junior Cooperative Officer in 
the office of the Central Registrar of Cooperative Societies under the Ministry of Cooperation namely:- 


l. Short title and commencement.-(|) These rules may be called the Ministry of Cooperation, Office of Central 
Registrar of Cooperative Societies, Additional Registrar, Joint Registrar, Deputy Registrar, Assistant Registrar, Senior 
Cooperative Officer and Junior Cooperative Officer (Group ‘A’ and Group ‘B’ Posts) Recruitment Rules, 2023. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. Application.-These rules shall apply to the posts as specified in column (l) of the Schedule annexed to these 
rules. 
3: Number of posts, classifications and level in pay matrix.-The number of the said posts, their classifications 


and level in the pay matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the said Schedule. 


4. Method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications, etc.-The method of recruitment, age-limit, qualifications 
and other matters relating to the said posts shall be as specified in columns (5) to ((3) of the said Schedule. 


5. Disqualification.-No person,- 

(a) _ who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 

(b) — who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any other person; 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said posts; 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal 
law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt 
any person from the operation of this rule. 


6. Power to relax.- Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it 
may, by order and for reasons to be recorded in writing, and in consultation with the Union Public Service 
Commission, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons. 


7. Savings.-Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age-limit and other concessions required 
to be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, the other backward classes, the Ex-servicemen and 
other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government from time to time 
in this regard.

MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS 
[Northern Railway (Construction Organization)] 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 4th September, 2023 


S.O. 3903(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 20A of the Railway 
Act, 989 (24 of 989) amended through Railways (Amendment) Act, 2008 (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), 
the Central Government, after being satisfied that for the public purpose, the land to be acquired, with or without 
structure, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for execution, maintenance, 
management and operation in connection with the Special Railway Project, namely, “Haryana Orbital Rail Corridor 
Project from Palwal to Sonipat via Sohna, Manesar and Kharkhoda” New Broad Gauge Double Rail Line on the 
stretch of land from K.M. 50.350 to K.M. 63.350 in the District of Gurugram in the state of Haryana, hereby declares 
its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition and use of such land for the aforesaid purpose 
under sub-section (l) of section 20D of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the competent authority, namely, Sub-Divisional Officer (Civil)-cum- 
Competent Authority (LA), Pataudi in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof & the competent authority shall 
give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all 
such objections & after making such further enquiry, if any, as the competent authority thinks necessary, by order, 
either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the competent authority under sub-section (2) of section 20D of the said Act shall be 
final.The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected by 
the interested person at the aforesaid office of the competent authority.

New Delhi, the 4th September, 2023 


S.O. 399(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S.O. 2848(E) dated 30/06/2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, 
Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of NH5I5 in the stretch of land from Km. 0+800 to Km. 27+70 (Package-l) (Office of the Deputy 
Commissioner, Dhemaji, Assam, India-787057) in the district of DHEMAJI in the state of ASSAM. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Assam Tribune” and “The 
Niyomiya Barta” both dated .07.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas no objections have been received by the Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 4th September, 2023 


S.O. 3920(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 3243 Dated:!9/07/2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of 
Greenfield Highway in the stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 42.9 (Development of six lane access control greenfield 
highway of Delhi-SaharanpurDehradun economic corridor) in the district of BAGHPAT in the state of UTTAR 
PRADESH. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Hindustan” and “Hindustan 
Times” both dated 25.07.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

है;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 4th September, 2023 


S.O. 3918(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 1920 Dated:26/04/2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part I, Section 3, 
Sub-section (1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of Southern Ludhiana Bypass from Km. 0.000 to Km. 26.000 (Greenfield) under Bharatmala Pariyojna in 
the district of Ludhiana in the state of Punjab. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Times Of India” and “Ajit” both 
dated 30.04.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

Dailythanthi” both dated 02.07.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 4th September, 2023 


S.O. 3928(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways vide S.O.No.4407 (E) dated 2.09.2022 published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, 
Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for 4 lanes access controlled (New NH-l63G) Green Field Highway 
from Warangal to Khammam for the stretch of land from Km. 203.800 to Km. 220.480 (Office of RDO, Khammam) 
in the District of Khammam in the State of TELANGANA. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Mana Telanagana” and “The 
Hindu” both dated 26.09.2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 


competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

New Delhi, the 4th September, 2023 
S.O. 3932(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for 
building(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH- 


344B in the stretch of land from Km 3.9 to Km 6.8 (Phagwara Hoshiarpur Section including Hoshiarpur Bypass) in 
the district of NAWANSHAHR in the state of PUNJAB, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(l) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, District Revenue Officer, SBS 
Nagar in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 
disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 4th September, 2023 


S.O. 3933(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act,1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/four laning etc.), maintenance, management and operation of National Highway No. 130A, on the stretch 
of land from Km. 15.600 to Km. 51.500 (Bilaspur-Urga Section) in the District Janjgir-Champa state of Chhattisgarh, 
hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


6 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub Divisional Officer ( Revenue) 
and Land Acquisition Officer Janjgir, District Janjgir-Champa (C.G.) in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof 
and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal 
practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent 
Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 4th September, 2023 


S.O. 3934(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH98 in the 
stretch of land from Km. 23.284 to Km. 57.041 (Palamu) in the district of PALAMU in the state of JHARKHAND, 
hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, District Land Acquisition Officer 
in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of 
being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making 
such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 
objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

S.O. 3935(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highways

Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 4th September, 2023 


S.O. 3940(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act,!956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for 
building(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH275 in the stretch of land from Km. 99.500 to Km. 223.860 (Mysuru-Madikeri section) in the district 
of MYSURU in the state of KARNATAKA, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in this News Paper, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section() of section 
3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Special Land Acquisition Officer & 
Competent Authoruty Mysuru with office at No.984, | st Floor, Geetha Road, Chamarajapuram Mysuru- 570005, 
(Phone No: 082-2333666) in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the 
objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such 
objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, 
either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 4th September, 2023 


S.O. 3941(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National 
Highways Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being 
satisfied that for the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is 
required for building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and 
operation of NH-530B in the stretch of land from Km. 123.1 to Km. 142.214 (Kasganj) in the district of Kasganj 
in the state of UTTAR PRADESH, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Additional District Magistrate 
(F&A) in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections 
and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow 
or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 
The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 


inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

कि.मी. 179.200 (पैकेज-ात) के 4 लेन में चौड़ीकरण एवं उन्नयन के कार्य एवं अंबेडकरनगर बाईपास के निर्माण 
(चौड़ीकरण/चार-लेन का बनाना आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है 
जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है, ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है | 


कोई भी व्यक्ति, जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3ग की उप-धारा (1) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा | 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी, अर्थात्‌ विशेष भूमि अध्याप्ति अधिकारी (सं.सं.) आजमगढ़ को लिखित रूप 
में किया जायेगा और उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी, आक्षेपकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप में 
या किसी विधिक व्यवसायी द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसे सभी आक्षेपो की सुनवाई के पश्चात्‌ तथा ऐसी और 
जाँच करने के पश्चात्‌, यदि कोई हो, जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे, आदेश द्वारा या तो आक्षेपो को अनुज्ञात कर 
सकेगा या अननुज्ञात कर सकेगा | 


उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3ग की उप-धारा (2) के अधीन सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा किया गया कोई भी आदेश

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 4th September, 2023 


S.O. 3942(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/Four Laning), Maintenance, management and operation of National Highway No. 135A, in the stretch of 
land in design chainage from Km. 139.00 to Km. 179.20 for Widening to 4 lane from Km. 139.00 to Km. 179.20 
Pkg-II (Jaunpur — Akbarpur section) and Akbarpur bypass of NH-135A in the State of Uttar Pradesh, hereby declares 
its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Special Land Acquisition Officer 
(J.O.), Azamgarh in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector 
an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections 
and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 


disallow the objections. 

Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 

The land plans and other details of the land covered under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.
